action_description: A 16-frame grounded sword attack. Keep frame 1 unchanged; frames 2-4 anticipate, frames 5-7 wind up to a readable charge, frames 8-10 strike and make contact, frames 11-13 follow through, and frames 14-16 recover.

frame 7 is the readable charge and skill-freeze pose
preserve sword length and hand contact
keep body and sword inside the canvas
